
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/23248541" title="发布于 2026-10-10 10:58">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">linux命令： watch 监视命令（高逼格必备）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>我们在执行linux命令的时候，有时候需要持续查看结果，此时需要反复执行某一个命令。<br>比如查看k8s pod 是否拉起，或者查看进程是否删除。一般就通过<br>⬆+回车 的组合不断的点，直到具体的结果。<br>但是这太麻烦了，而且太low，作为一个成熟的操作系统，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )linux早已有相应的命令。<br>watch 命令<br>watch 在英语中的的本意是 持续监视/站岗/守望/观察的意思</p>
<p>watch 命令也很简单：<br>watch + &lt;要持续观察的命令&gt; </p>
<p>举个例子</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>watch <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ps</span> -ef</pre>
</div>
<p>输出：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Every 2.0s: ps -ef                                                                                     kcs-m-b8hn9: Fri Oct  9 17:57:46 2026</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

UID         PID   PPID  C STIME TTY          TIME CMD
root          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>      <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2025</span> ?        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">08</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">14</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span> /usr/lib/systemd/systemd --system --deserialize <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
root          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>      <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2025</span> ?        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">45</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [kthreadd]
root          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>      <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2025</span> ?        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [rcu_gp]
root          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>      <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2025</span> ?        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [rcu_par_gp]
root          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span>      <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2025</span> ?        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span> [kworker/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>:0H-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kblockd]
root          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>      <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2025</span> ?        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">00</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [mm_percpu_wq]
....</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">红色不部分是标题行，</span></strong></p>
<p>左上角表示持续监视的周期，默认是每两秒执行一次。<br>右上角是当前监视的时间点。下边就是执行命令的结果了。</p>
<p>如果我们想要执行管道命令，可以通过单/双引号，包裹要执行的命令。如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>[root@kcs ~]#  watch <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ps -ef | grep java</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
[root@kcs </span>~]#  watch <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ps -ef | grep java</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span></pre>
</div>
<p>除此之外，watch 还提供了一些高级参数，来提升watch的能力：<br>-n 调整watch命令的监视周期，单位是s<br>如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>watch -n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ps -ef |grep java</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这种就是每0.1秒执行一次</p>
<p>-d d是difference的意思，作用是高亮本次执行的结果和上一次执行结果的差异<br>效果如下图：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/704073/202610/704073-20261010105145501-865753127.png" alt="watch-d" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>-t 不显示标题行，就是屏蔽红色字体写的 周期/当前时间点这些数据，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )平常很少用，会在写复杂脚本的时候，去掉头部数据</p>
<p>-g 当发生变化时退出watch监控，也就是当发现本次监控和上一次监控存在不同时，直接立刻退出监控界面</p>
<p>-e 当执行的命令返回错误状态（非0）时，退出，<br>啥时候会返回错误状态呢，比如我们进入一个不存在的路径<br>watch -n 0.1  -e 'cd abc'<br>效果如下图，此时不是立刻退出监控界面，而是按任意键</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/704073/202610/704073-20261010105202969-1657256566.png" alt="watch-e" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
